scope_limits: Dedicated released-binary cases, ordinary native ARM64 and strict x86 Clippy qualify only the exact named head and tested merge.
Synthetic bus, authored trigger inputs and Policy refusal only; no physical output, rested state, real providers, updater installation or physical reboot/power-loss durability.
Published binaries were captured and checked by the CI fixtures; this audit verified their retained pins and the full evidence archive, and did not independently re-download the executable assets.
Snapshot copies are deliberately written0600 by fixture.rs:82-91. Their bytes and sizes were verified; original live modes are retained in files.json, not reproduced by the snapshot copy mode.
Raw identity-bearing API objects, full workflow logs, archives and executable payloads are retained privately; only derived safe metadata and case text are selected for publication.

Two package cases exercise local unsigned pack/install/list commands only. Cloud provenance reading, Store trust/signatures, full product catalog, updater folder recovery, physical output and power-loss durability are not qualified.

Package implementation is identical across the two named releases despite distinct executable payloads. The package CLI identity is direct private execution with before/after hashes, not live /proc verification.
The ordinary nextest total includes one LEAK-marked pass; its captured nested output is not counted again. Skipped names are not listed in the run log.
